_readme: The longest SOURCE LINE on each page, in words, measured at 1440x900 on 2026-09-01.
page-design.md budgets apparatus ink at 45 words per figure: one source line plus at
most one limitation sentence, with the rest going to the methodology box or the
register. Nothing measured it until a scored editorial rubric found METHODOLOGY BALANCE
the weakest dimension on the site, failing at severity 4+ on 14 of 23 pages. The
measurement behind that verdict: 60 source lines over budget, 6,902 words of source-line
ink, one line of 318 words on reach and one of 257 on atlas.
A RATCHET, not a target, for the reason coldopen is one: every page is already over, so
a hard line would fail the build today and be switched off by Friday. A page listed here
may only improve. A page NOT listed must clear 45 outright, so new apparatus cannot be
born in debt. Three pages already clear it: revisions, funding-map, realwage.
Lower a number when you pay it down. Never lower one by DELETING a limitation: the
budget is about where apparatus lives, not about whether a reader is warned.
